domains.name: Universal App Campaigns and Asset Groups
Bidding and Optimization for App Install

exam_rules: Exams are taken online via Google Skillshop. No external proctor is required. A Google account is needed to access and take the exams. Most certifications are valid for 1 year and must be renewed by retaking the exam. There is typically a 1-day waiting period before retaking a failed Google Ads exam.
id_requirements: Google account login required. No government-issued ID required. All exams are unproctored and taken online at skillshop.google.com.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-23: Google's Skillshop lists the certification - 'Google Ads Apps Certification ... Demonstrate your mastery of creating Google App campaigns to deliver business impact. Certified users will show they understand the fundamentals of campaign creation and advanced optimization strategies.' - with a live assessment section in its outline ('Course Outline 4 Sections 17 Activities 2 hours 47 minutes Section 1, Prepare for the certification (Optional) Section 2, Pass the assessment and earn a certification Section 3, Study Google Ads Apps (Optional) Section 4, Elevate Your App Campaign (Optional)').

renewal_options: Certifications expire after 1 year. Renewal requires passing the current version of the exam at skillshop.google.com.

retake_policy.notes: Candidates must wait 1 day after a failed attempt before retaking a Google Ads exam. Google Digital Garage retake policies may differ. No cost for retakes.
